lessons: A use_figma script that throws is rolled back entirely, so a retry after a fix is safe
Deep text restore after swap+resetOverrides must skip duplicate layer paths (lists of Menu items or Calendar days all received the last label)
Setting x/y on a focus ring inside a nested instance throws (relative-transform cannot be overridden); place rings only on the set's own parts
New auto-layout frames clip content by default: set clipsContent=false on review/strip frames or the 3-5px double ring is cut
Probe with a one-line read before re-sending a large script after a rate-limit refusal; every refused large script costs context
Iterating findAll() results while swapping nested instances invalidates sibling ids ('node does not exist'); collect direct parts with a walk that stops at instances, or re-query after each swap
Glyphs like ▲/▼ need the 'Noto Sans Symbols2' fallback loaded before text-style bindings

swapKeep (reset + restore props) loses nested instance state such as selected rows or badge tones; re-apply the state that matters after swapping composites, or use a plain swap when the layer tree matches
